name: C++ (CMake + vcpkg)
description: C++20 executable with CMake presets, Ninja, vcpkg manifest mode and a CTest test.
notes: Dependencies: add them to vcpkg.json ("dependencies": ["fmt"]) and use find_package() in CMakeLists.txt; vcpkg installs them automatically during configure (VCPKG_ROOT=/opt/vcpkg). The build directory is ./build. Debug with gdb ./build/{{cident}}.
